Hello Kosar,

Thank you for your message, and we are sorry to hear about your situation. We understand this must be a difficult time for you.

Please note that your booking was made under a non-refundable rate, and unfortunately, we are unable to process a refund as per the booking terms.

However, you may also check with your agent, Sobhi, as he may be able to assist you further or advise on any available options.

Thank you for your understanding, and we wish you and your family all the best during this time.
